newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday publicly beheaded a Pakistani man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, the Interior Ministry said.
The execution in the capital Riyadh raised to 69 the number of convicted criminals beheaded in the conservative Islamic country so far this year, compared with a total of 68 in 1996.
He was the fifth Pakistani to be put to death on drugs charges this month.
A ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said the man was beheaded by the sword after being convicted of smuggling an unspecified quantity of the drug.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug traffickers and other criminals.
